capabilities: Publish a note as a public webpage
Update an existing share on save
disambiguation: Not Obsidian Publish or a local sharing tool; the note is uploaded to the third-party htmlto.link service.
extras: Guest shares expire after 24 hours; an API token gives account-bound shares with longer retention. Published notes and referenced local images are uploaded to a third-party server and are viewable by anyone with the public URL.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a note into a public, styled webpage with a link you can hand out.

relations.evidence: Instantly share any Obsidian note as a beautiful webpage via htmlto.link and copy the public link.

summary: Publishes a note to htmlto.link as a styled public webpage and copies the share link, with local template previews and update-on-save.
